Layers of Hell

Manufactured Falsehood

Shining corridors built from lies rewrite every promising exit.

Profaned Ambition

An endless ascent toward a throne that recedes with every gain.

Betrayal

Every attempt to reach warmth tightens the chain around the betrayer.

Poem of 3 Layers

Manufactured Falsehood

In halls of light that shift with every lie Pinocchio runs through the hallways that glow, His wooden breath grows thinner, stretched and dry. Each door he trusts dissolves to what he knows, A path that bends the moment he believes, His voice is traded for the lies he chose. The nose extends with every trick he weaves, Each corridor reflects a fractured face, Until no truth is something he receives.

Profaned Ambition

Above the flames, Macbeth begins his chase, He climbs on bodies stacked onto a throne, Each step a life he cast aside in haste. The crown retreats the closer he has grown, His hands still marked by blood he cannot hide, Each rung cries out in voices of its own. Ambition burns, but nothing satisfies, The throne ascends beyond his final breath, While all he crushed still stares him in the eyes.

Betrayal

Below the frost stands Anakin Skywalker in death, His chains are forged from trust he tore apart, Each link remembers every broken breath. He pulls for warmth, but tightens on his own heart, The metal squeezes and takes him further in, The distance unchanged from the start. For every traitor bound within this sin, The pain they dealt is all they ever fell, They drag themselves through ice they placed within

Punishment
